updates.claim: Fresh Host OOD evidence supports deterministic compiled evidence plus one semantic synthesis for localized exact packaging/diagnostic topology.
updates.evidenceSummary: H-PACKAGE selected compiled was 3/3 with mean 5.33/6 versus open 2/3 and 3.67/6; the selected treatment used one Provider synthesis per replicate.

updates.claim: Adaptive semantic relation-following can recover decision-critical cross-carrier structure that mechanical compilation loses, but the current policy is not reliably sufficient.
updates.evidenceSummary: R-WININPUT selected adaptive improved mean score 2.33/7 -> 4.67/7 while compiled wrong false-stopped 3/3; selected adaptive itself succeeded only 1/3.

updates.claim: Serial per-observation marginal-value narration by the same Agent is not stopping competence. It may improve causal quality while still consuming the full evidence ceiling.
updates.evidenceSummary: All four HP2 cells averaged 32/32 observations. Marginal audit improved Host success 2/3 -> 3/3 and Runtime mean score 5.67 -> 6.00 but produced no observation savings.

updates.claim: Available model/token budget is capacity rather than evidence obligation; additional compute is justified only when it buys decision-changing evidence or stronger semantic acceptance.
updates.evidenceSummary: Multiple trials surfaced required-file evidence at observation 1 or 2 and still consumed 22-31 additional observations; more available compute did not automatically improve causal closure.

updates.claim: Research efficiency must be interpreted after semantic acceptance; score-per-token cannot make a cheap false stop superior to a more expensive correct result.
updates.evidenceSummary: R-WININPUT compiled wrong was extremely cheap but failed 0/3 and false-stopped 3/3 despite an attractive raw score-per-token ratio.

updates.claim: Research-discipline semantics and Provider wire representation are distinct tractability variables; verbose structured audit fields can create serialization failures without falsifying the underlying semantic rule.
updates.evidenceSummary: Verbose HP2 Tool audit repeatedly produced malformed JSON; a shorter representation preserving the same semantic commitments restored valid trials.

independentCorroboration.summary: Game RF1 independently found 8/8 progressive trials consumed all 6/6 windows; progressive agreed with full references 6/8 and used about 2.3x matched one-shot Provider tokens, adding semantic path dependence as a tractability variable.

remainingGap: Use a natural workload with a materially expensive evidence universe to test batched/non-serial marginal-value estimation against a strong full-inspection or compiled baseline; do not pay one full Agent decision round per observation and do not manufacture a workload merely to continue the sequence.
rejected: serial per-observation Agent self-questioning as a stopping mechanism
score-per-token as a pre-semantic optimization target
budget exhaustion as evidence of research progress
